On Saturday, May 29, 2021, at approximately 0109 hours, I was on routine patrol in a marked Placentia Police Department black and white Ford SUV, Unit #15.
claims.evidence_observations: The transcript states the speaker is Sergeant Joe Connell, and the claim describes being on routine patrol in a marked Placentia Police Department black and white Ford SUV, Unit #15. The transcript also mentions the date and time (May 29, 2021, approximately 0109 hours), which aligns with the claim.

claims.claim_text: My vehicle was equipped with overhead emergency lights, side spotlights, and a Patrol Video System (PVS).
claims.evidence_observations: The transcript states 'My vehicle was equipped with overhead emergency lights, side spotlights, and a Patrol Video System (PVS).' The bodycam footage shows flashing lights and a camera view, indicating the presence of these features.

claims.claim_text: Both the PVS and my Body Worn Camera were activated throughout the incident.
claims.evidence_observations: The bodycam footage timestamp shows the recording is active, and the transcript states that the Body Worn Camera was activated throughout the incident.

claims.claim_text: I was in full PPD uniform.
claims.evidence_observations: The speaker is identified as Sergeant Joe Connell, and the claim states he was in full PPD uniform. The video shows him in a police uniform, which aligns with the claim.

claims.claim_text: While northbound through the rear parking lot of the shopping center, I observed a gray four-door Honda Accord, California license plate #5AMS437, parked in the northernmost marked stall behind Ralph's Grocery, south of a cinderblock dumpster enclosure.
claims.evidence_observations: The video shows a dark-colored vehicle (possibly black or dark gray), but the claim specifies a gray four-door Honda Accord with license plate #5AMS437. The vehicle color and model are not confirmed in the clip.

claims.claim_text: The vehicle was parked head-in, facing east.
claims.evidence_observations: The video shows the officer approaching the vehicle, but the specific orientation (head-in, facing east) is not visible or audible in this clip.

claims.claim_text: I found it suspicious that a car would be parked behind a closed shopping center at that hour.
claims.evidence_observations: The transcript states the officer observed a suspicious vehicle parked behind a closed shopping center at night, which aligns with the claim about the car being parked behind a closed shopping center at that hour.

claims.claim_text: I have patrolled this center approximately three times per week and have rarely encountered vehicles there at night.
claims.evidence_observations: The transcript states the officer patrolled the center approximately three times per week and rarely encountered vehicles at night, which supports the claim about his patrol frequency and rarity of nighttime vehicles.

claims.claim_text: I pulled in behind the Honda, activated my spotlights, and attempted to see inside the vehicle.
claims.evidence_observations: The transcript states the officer pulled in behind the Honda, activated spotlights, and attempted to see inside, which aligns with the claim about pulling in behind the Honda and activating spotlights.

claims.claim_text: Due to heavy dark tint on all windows, I was unable to observe the interior.
claims.evidence_observations: The transcript states the officer was unable to observe the interior due to heavy dark tint on all windows, which supports the claim about the inability to see inside.

claims.claim_text: I approached the driver's door and illuminated the inside of the vehicle with my handheld flashlight.
claims.evidence_observations: The transcript states the officer approached the driver's door and illuminated the inside with a handheld flashlight, which supports the claim about illuminating the vehicle's interior.

claims.claim_text: I observed the subject, later identified as Kevin Tran, seated in the driver's seat.
claims.evidence_observations: The transcript states the officer observed the subject seated in the driver's seat, which supports the claim about the subject's location.

claims.claim_text: Due to the window tint, I could not determine whether there were other occupants.
claims.evidence_observations: The transcript states the officer could not determine if there were other occupants due to window tint, which supports the claim about not being able to see other occupants.

claims.claim_text: At approximately 0110 hours, I radioed PPD Dispatch that I was conducting a vehicle check.
claims.evidence_observations: The transcript states the officer radioed dispatch at approximately 0110 hours, which supports the claim about the time of the radio call.

claims.claim_text: I spent approximately five minutes attempting to convince the subject to open the door or roll down the window so that I could speak with him.
claims.evidence_observations: The transcript states the officer spent approximately five minutes attempting to get the subject to comply, which supports the claim about the duration of the attempt.

claims.claim_text: The subject initially ignored my requests.
claims.evidence_observations: The transcript states the subject initially ignored the officer's requests, which supports the claim about the subject ignoring requests.

claims.claim_text: I knocked repeatedly on the window and asked the subject to roll down the window.
claims.evidence_observations: The transcript states the officer knocked repeatedly on the window and asked the subject to roll down the window, which supports the claim about knocking and asking to roll down the window.

claims.claim_text: The subject did not comply.
claims.evidence_observations: The transcript states the subject did not comply, which supports the claim about non-compliance.

claims.claim_text: At approximately 0112 hours, the subject started the engine.
claims.evidence_observations: The transcript states the subject started the engine at approximately 0112 hours, which supports the claim about the timing of the engine start.

claims.claim_text: I yelled at him to roll down the window and requested Code 1 assistance over the radio.
claims.evidence_observations: The transcript states the officer yelled at the subject to roll down the window and requested Code 1 assistance, which supports the claim about yelling and requesting assistance.

claims.claim_text: Shortly after, the subject lowered the driver's side window approximately two to three inches.
claims.evidence_observations: The video shows the subject lowering the window only a few inches, not two to three inches as claimed.

claims.claim_text: The subject stated, "How's it going?"
claims.evidence_observations: The transcript states the subject said, "How's it going?" which supports the claim about the subject's statement.

claims.claim_text: I responded, "It's going alright man. Can you roll down the window all the way?"
claims.evidence_observations: The transcript states the officer responded, "It's going alright man. Can you roll down the window all the way?" which supports the claim about the officer's response.

claims.claim_text: The subject did not comply and shortly thereafter turned off the engine.
claims.evidence_observations: The transcript states the subject did not comply and turned off the engine, which supports the claim about non-compliance and engine shutdown.

claims.claim_text: Over the next several minutes, I continued to give the subject verbal commands to roll down the window.
claims.evidence_observations: The transcript states the officer continued to give verbal commands for several minutes, which supports the claim about continued verbal commands.

claims.claim_text: The subject intermittently lowered the window a few inches and then immediately raised it again.
claims.evidence_observations: The transcript states the subject intermittently lowered and raised the window, which supports the claim about the window movement.

claims.claim_text: At one point, the subject restarted the engine, placed the vehicle in reverse, and backed up several inches before placing it back in park.
claims.evidence_observations: The transcript states the subject restarted the engine, placed it in reverse, backed up, and placed it back in park, which supports the claim about the vehicle movement.

claims.claim_text: I broadcast over the radio that the vehicle was trying to leave.
claims.evidence_observations: The transcript states the officer broadcast that the vehicle was trying to leave, which supports the claim about broadcasting the vehicle's movement.

claims.claim_text: Officer Coelho arrived on scene and parked his marked PPD patrol vehicle, Unit #13, perpendicular to the driver's side of the Honda.
claims.evidence_observations: The transcript states Officer Coelho arrived and parked his vehicle perpendicular to the driver's side of the Honda, which supports the claim about his arrival and parking.

claims.claim_text: Both Officer Coelho and I observed the subject making repeated furtive movements inside the vehicle, reaching below the window line where we could not see his hands.
claims.evidence_observations: The transcript states both officers observed the subject making furtive movements and reaching below the window line, which supports the claim about the subject's movements.

claims.claim_text: Officer Coelho asked, "What are you reaching for?"
claims.evidence_observations: The transcript states Officer Coelho asked, "What are you reaching for?" which supports the claim about his question.

claims.claim_text: I stated, "I don't know what you're reaching for, but you need to stop reaching."
claims.evidence_observations: The transcript states the officer said, "I don't know what you're reaching for, but you need to stop reaching," which supports the claim about his statement.

claims.claim_text: I told Officer Coelho that I did not know if the subject was arming himself and that I intended to use my ASP baton to break the window.
claims.evidence_observations: The transcript states the officer told Officer Coelho he did not know if the subject was arming himself and intended to use his ASP baton, which supports the claim about his intent and actions.

claims.claim_text: Officer Coelho recommended we wait for additional units.
claims.evidence_observations: The transcript states Officer Coelho recommended waiting for additional units, which supports the claim about his recommendation.

claims.evidence_observations: The transcript states that Officers Vega, Cruz, Pratt, Sergeant Bishop, and Acting Sergeant Chen arrived on scene, which supports the claim about their arrival.

claims.claim_text: During that time, Officer Coelho and I remained near the Honda with our handguns drawn and repeatedly instructed the subject to roll down the window and show us his hands.
claims.evidence_observations: The transcript states both officers remained near the Honda with handguns drawn and repeatedly instructed the subject to comply, which supports the claim about their actions and commands.

claims.claim_text: The subject refused to comply with any of our commands.
claims.evidence_observations: The transcript states the subject refused to comply with any commands, which supports the claim about refusal to comply.

claims.claim_text: At approximately 0121 hours, Sergeant Bishop ordered the subject to turn off the vehicle.
claims.evidence_observations: The transcript states Sergeant Bishop ordered the subject to turn off the vehicle at approximately 0121 hours, which supports the claim about the order.

claims.claim_text: The subject refused.
claims.evidence_observations: The transcript states the subject refused to turn off the vehicle, which supports the claim about refusal.

claims.evidence_observations: The transcript states dispatch advised no firearms were registered to the subject, which supports the claim about firearm registration.

claims.evidence_observations: The transcript states Officer Pratt positioned himself behind the open driver door of Unit #13 approximately ten to fifteen feet south of the Honda, which supports the claim about his positioning.

claims.evidence_observations: The transcript states for approximately three and a half minutes, Officer Vega gave repeated commands, which supports the claim about the duration of commands.

claims.evidence_observations: The transcript states the subject was told he was being detained, which supports the claim about detention.

claims.evidence_observations: The transcript states the subject refused to comply and kept his hands below the window frame, which supports the claim about hand position and movement.
